title: Adversaries Oppose the Building

questions.question: Who heard that the returned exiles were building a temple?
options: The adversaries of Judah and Benjamin
questions.correctAnswer: The adversaries of Judah and Benjamin
questions.explanation: Ezra 4:1 (ESV): "Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the returned exiles were building a temple..."

questions.question: What did the adversaries ask Zerubbabel?
questions.explanation: Ezra 4:2 (ESV): "...Let us build with you, for we worship your God as you do..."

questions.question: How did Zerubbabel respond?
options: You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God
questions.correctAnswer: You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God
questions.explanation: Ezra 4:3 (ESV): "...You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we alone will build..."

questions.question: What did the people of the land do to the people of Judah?
options: Discouraged them and made them afraid to build
questions.correctAnswer: Discouraged them and made them afraid to build
questions.explanation: Ezra 4:4 (ESV): "Then the people of the land discouraged the people of Judah and made them afraid to build..."

questions.question: To which king did they write a letter against Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Ezra 4:7 (ESV): "In the days of Artaxerxes... wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia."

questions.question: What did they call Jerusalem in the letter?
questions.explanation: Ezra 4:12 (ESV): "...they are rebuilding that rebellious and evil city..."

questions.question: What would happen if the city was rebuilt according to the letter?
options: They will not pay tribute, custom, or toll
questions.correctAnswer: They will not pay tribute, custom, or toll
questions.explanation: Ezra 4:13 (ESV): "...they will not pay tribute, custom, or toll..."

questions.question: What did the king do after reading the letter?
options: He made a decree to stop the work
questions.correctAnswer: He made a decree to stop the work
questions.explanation: Ezra 4:21 (ESV): "Therefore make a decree that these men be made to cease, and that this city be not rebuilt..."

questions.question: Until when did the work on the house of God cease?
options: Until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia
questions.correctAnswer: Until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia
questions.explanation: Ezra 4:24 (ESV): "Then the work... ceased, and it ceased until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia."

questions.question: What language was the letter written in?
questions.explanation: Ezra 4:7 (ESV): "...The letter was written in Aramaic and translated."

questions.question: Who wrote the letter in the days of Artaxerxes?
questions.explanation: Ezra 4:7 (ESV): "...Bishlam and Mithredath and Tabeel and the rest of their associates wrote..."

questions.question: Who were Rehum and Shimshai?
options: Rehum the commander and Shimshai the scribe
questions.correctAnswer: Rehum the commander and Shimshai the scribe
questions.explanation: Ezra 4:8 (ESV): "Rehum the commander and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem..."

questions.question: Who settled the nations in the cities of Samaria according to the letter?
questions.explanation: Ezra 4:10 (ESV): "and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Osnappar deported and settled in the cities of Samaria..."

questions.question: Where did the king have the search made?
options: In the book of the records of his fathers
questions.correctAnswer: In the book of the records of his fathers
questions.explanation: Ezra 4:15 (ESV): "that search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers..."

questions.question: How did Rehum and Shimshai stop the Jews?
questions.explanation: Ezra 4:23 (ESV): "...and went in haste to the Jews at Jerusalem and by force and power made them cease."

key_verse_text: But Zerubbabel, Jeshua, and the rest of the heads of fathers' houses in Israel said to them, “You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we alone will build to the LORD, the God of Israel, as King Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us.”
